1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and a pair of flanges extending from the web, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void, wherein the filler comprises a material selected from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive that is distinct from any resin contained within the reinforcing fiber bundle of the filler.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and wherein the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive that is applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin matrix of the composite members.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix, and wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a separate reinforcing layer distinct from the laminated composite tape plies of the members.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, and wherein the adhesive layer is a structural adhesive applied as a distinct layer separate from any adhesive resin contained within the laminated composite tape.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and wherein the offset is created by deliberate placement of the fabric layers rather than by wrinkles or deformation in the tape plies.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone, wherein the reinforcing member is selected from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate reinforcing layer; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive distinct from any resin contained within the reinforcing fiber bundle of the reinforcing member.

8. (Original)

9. (Original)

10. (Original)

11. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, __and__ a titanium member.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, and wherein the patches are applied as separate reinforcing layers distinct from the laminated composite tape plies of the channels and base.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a distinct layer separate from any resin matrix of the channels and base.

14. (Original)

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are formed from laminated composite tape and are joined together with the base through the structural adhesive layer, and wherein the structural adhesive is a distinct layer applied separately from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape plies.

16. (Currently amended) A method of fabricating a composite stiffener, comprising: forming a pair of composite channels each having a flange and a radius portion, using composite fiber tape; placing a layer of composite fiber fabric over the radius portion of each of the channels, wherein the fabric layer is applied as a separate reinforcing layer; forming a base using composite fiber tape; placing a reinforcing filler in at least a portion of the base; placing a layer of structural adhesive around the filler, wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a distinct layer separate from any resin contained within the composite fiber tape; assembling the channels and base such that the radius portions and the base form a radius filler zone between the radius portions of the channels and the base; and, curing the assembly.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the forming of the channels and base includes laying up unidirectional composite fiber tape plies with reinforcing fibers.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein placing the structural adhesive includes wrapping the filler with a sheet of adhesive, wherein the sheet of adhesive is a structural adhesive distinct from any resin matrix of the composite fiber tape.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, further comprising: placing layers of composite fiber fabric on sections of each of the channels and the base outside the radius filler zone; and, introducing a layer of structural adhesive between the layers of composite fiber fabric on the sections outside the radius filler zone, wherein the structural adhesive is distinct from any resin contained within the composite fiber tape.

20. (Currently amended) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener, comprising: forming a composite structure having a web and a pair of flanges extending in opposite directions from the web, wherein the structure is formed from laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges; joining a surface of a cap to the flanges; applying a layer of composite fabric to the surface of the cap joined to the flanges, wherein the fabric layer is applied as a separate reinforcing layer; placing a reinforcing filler between the web, the flanges and the cap; and, using a structural adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers on the composite structure and the cap, wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a distinct layer separate from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape plies.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein: forming the composite structure includes forming the laminated tape plies into first and second channels, and applying a layer of composite fabric over the laminated composite tape plies includes placing patches of the composite fabric on selected areas of the first and second channels as separate reinforcing layers.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21, further comprising: placing a layer of composite fabric on facing surfaces of each of the first and second channels; introducing a structural adhesive between the layers of composite fabric on the facing surfaces of the first and second channels, wherein the structural adhesive is distinct from any resin matrix of the composite fabric; and, joining the first and second channels together at the facing surfaces.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein using a structural adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers includes wrapping a layer of structural adhesive around the filler, wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a distinct layer separate from any resin contained within the reinforcing filler.

24. (Currently amended) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: forming multi-ply lay-ups of unidirectional composite tape; forming the lay-ups into first and second C-channels, a cap and a base; assembling the C-channels, the cap and the base into an I-section structure having a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web; applying composite fabric to surfaces of the C-channels, the cap and the base in areas forming radius filler zones at the intersection of the web with the cap and with the base, wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate reinforcing layer; selecting a reinforcing filler from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member; wrapping the reinforcing filler with a structural adhesive that is distinct from any resin contained within the reinforcing filler; placing the reinforcing filler and the structural adhesive in the radius filler zone; and curing the assembly.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a pair of composite channels with radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap and a base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the composite channels, the cap and the base, wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate reinforcing layer; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone, wherein the filler is selected from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein the structural adhesive is distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape or the reinforcing filler.
